1 (Currently amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium that does not harm the viability of the embryos__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially __of water or a solution that does not harm the viability of the embryos__.

7 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a cell wall degrading enzyme__.

11 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __immature plant embryos__.

12 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in a __quiescent condition__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __selected from the group consisting of genotyping, sequencing, and PCR analysis__.

17 (Currently amended): The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __the results of the molecular analysis__. 

18 (Currently amended): The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos. 

19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __performed using automated techniques__.
